title: Amazing Thabo Midnight Marathon 2027 Review: Another Mekong Border Race
seo_title: Amazing Thabo Midnight Marathon 2027 Review | Nong Khai
meta_description: Amazing Thabo Midnight Marathon 2027 review: May 1 in Tha Bo, Nong Khai -- a nighttime marathon on the Mekong, near the Pho Tak Marathon's home province.
dek: Set for 1 May 2027 in Tha Bo, Nong Khai, this nighttime marathon runs in the same Mekong River province as the Pho Tak Marathon covered elsewhere in this research, adding another race to Thailand's growing roster of after-dark events.
verdict: The Amazing Thabo Midnight Marathon adds a fourth nighttime-branded race to this research batch, alongside HOKA Midnight Run Asia, VnExpress Marathon Hanoi Midnight, and the Bangkok Midnight Marathon -- confirming nighttime racing as a genuine, growing Southeast Asian format rather than an isolated experiment. It's held in Tha Bo, within Nong Khai province, the same Mekong River border region hosting the well-established Pho Tak Marathon covered elsewhere in this research. Four distances (5K to full marathon) with registration already open make this an accessible pick.

sections.heading: A Fourth Nighttime-Branded Race
paragraphs: The Amazing Thabo Midnight Marathon offers four distances -- 5K, 10K, 21.1K and the 42.195K full marathon -- in Tha Bo, Nong Khai. [1] This is the fourth explicitly nighttime-branded race covered in this research batch, joining the HOKA Midnight Run Asia series, VnExpress Marathon Hanoi Midnight, and the Bangkok Midnight Marathon -- confirming this as a genuine, growing Southeast Asian racing format rather than a one-off novelty.

sections.heading: Nong Khai's Second Covered Race
paragraphs: Tha Bo sits within Nong Khai province, the same Mekong River border region hosting the well-established, 6th-edition Pho Tak Marathon covered elsewhere in this research batch. [2] Nong Khai holds the longest stretch of the Mekong within Thailand at 320km, and serves as the country's main crossing point to Vientiane, Laos -- giving both races in this province genuine river-border character.

sections.heading: Registration Already Open
paragraphs: Unlike several other races in this final batch still awaiting registration confirmation, the Amazing Thabo Midnight Marathon is already open for sign-up. [1] That's a meaningful advantage for runners wanting to plan travel now.

sections.heading: Wide Distance Range
paragraphs: The 5K-to-42K spread gives this race genuine broad accessibility, similar to most full-service marathons covered throughout this research batch. [1]

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want to try Thailand's growing nighttime-racing format in a genuinely distinctive Mekong River border province, the Amazing Thabo Midnight Marathon on 1 May 2027 is a strong, accessible pick with registration already open.

faqs.question: Is this related to other Midnight-branded races?
faqs.answer: Not directly organisationally, but it joins HOKA Midnight Run Asia, VnExpress Marathon Hanoi Midnight, and the Bangkok Midnight Marathon covered elsewhere in this research as part of a genuine, growing nighttime-racing trend across Southeast Asia. [1]

faqs.question: Is this the same as the Pho Tak Marathon?
faqs.answer: No, but both are held in Nong Khai province, on the Mekong River border with Laos -- Pho Tak Marathon is a well-established, 6th-edition race covered elsewhere in this research, while this is a separate nighttime event in Tha Bo. [2]

faqs.question: Is registration open?
faqs.answer: Yes -- registration is already open across all four distances (5K, 10K, 21.1K, and the full marathon), a meaningful advantage over several other races in this research batch still awaiting confirmation. [1]
